slo_policy: Synthetic benchmark thresholds fixed before engine measurements; not production requirements
scope: closed-loop control; open-loop and true static batch excluded
formal_selection: all screened cells with >=30 successes in every repeat and zero errors; failed cells retained
long_mixed_gate: first three workloads must have valid formal results on both engines
restoration: restore production container definitions; original services initially stopped
tokenizer_gate: passed: identical messages and token IDs in both installed images

pool_alignment.note: SGLang formulas require runtime allocation confirmation; vLLM pooled hybrid capacity differs from fixed SGLang pool

batch_shape_warmup: one excluded 8-output-token wave at each cell concurrency and input shape
startup_probe: deduplicated actual tensor storage; zero CPU model parameter bytes required
baseline_scope: startup, no-service, warm idle, post-request and post-stop; no offload ablation
sampling_gate: >=50 host/GPU samples, >=55s span, <=5s maximum gap per 60s window
